title: Elite tier guide: when to upgrade your fortnite cheats
desc: Loot Assist, Auto Finish, Skin Changer and full ESP wallhack—who Elite is for and how to tune safely.

body.text: [Elite](/products/fortnite-cheats/elite/) is the private fortnite cheats build at fnhacks.org—limited slots, priority patch queue, and every module from Lite and Pro plus bots, Auto Finish, Auto Shield Break, full ESP wallhack, and Skin Changer.
What Elite is

[Elite](/products/fortnite-cheats/elite/) is the private fortnite cheats build at fnhacks.org—limited slots, priority patch queue, and every module from Lite and Pro plus bots, Auto Finish, Auto Shield Break, full ESP wallhack, and Skin Changer.
Elite is not day-one software; it is for operators who already win on Pro and want the full toolkit without module gaps.
What Elite adds over Pro
Loot Assist, Auto Finish, Auto Shield Break, complete ESP wallhack suite with smoke and vision tuning, Skin Changer, stack timers, loadout manager, and direct dev support on Discord.
Patch delivery hits Elite first when EAC or game updates land—critical for high-rank operators who cannot afford downtime.
Who should upgrade
Upgrade after two or more weeks of clean Pro sessions with conservative aim smoothness. Stay on Pro if you are still learning Aimbot basics or play casually on weekends.
Elite power without discipline increases report volume in Ranked. If you die to hostile players with Lite ESP on, fix ESP wallhack settings before buying bots.
Safe Elite tuning
Load Elite conservative presets from the portal—not max bots on day one. Test Auto Finish in instances before Ranked. Enable Loot Assist only when you understand farm-route timing impact.
ESP wallhack: start at 1200 unit ESP max; expand after clean games. Details: [ESP wallhack setup](/blog/fortnite-esp-wallhack-setup/). Smoke alerts at medium sensitivity reduce false positives.
Skin Changer on Elite

Elite bundles [Skin Changer](/blog/fortnite-skin-changer-guide/) with automation—cosmetic preview plus Ranked aimbot in one dashboard. Standalone Unlock All exists if you only want visuals without bots.
Streamers pair Skin Changer with [stream-proof setup](/blog/fortnite-stream-proof-setup/)—test OBS capture separately from ESP hiding.
Elite external architecture

All tiers including Elite use external architecture—see [external cheat guide](/blog/fortnite-external-cheat-guide/). Cloud config sync and patch delivery run through the operator portal, not a separate game client.
Elite operators get priority cloud sync bundles on patch days before Lite and Pro public builds.
Get Elite access

Review the full feature map in our [cheats features guide](/blog/fortnite-cheats-features-guide/), compare [Lite vs Pro](/blog/fortnite-lite-vs-pro/) if unsure, then checkout [Elite](/products/fortnite-cheats/elite/) via secure checkout at fnhacks.org.
Discord #elite channel covers tuning questions—bring your player pool and rank bracket for preset recommendations.
